acceptanceCriteria:
A blocker can record a typed condition: commit ancestor of ; path

exists at ; symbol defined at . Free text remains allowed.

When the deployment ref or source changes, open typed blockers are re-evaluated at the first status read; satisfied ones show UNBLOCKED (condition met at <ref>) in status and doctor, and the item routes back to its work stage or to the operator per policy. A blocker 'commit X ancestor of DEPLOY' flips in the first status read after DEPLOY moves to a descendant of X.
doctor lists free-text blockers that name a sha or path whose condition is already met at the deployment ref.
doctor reports role prompts/operator notes that pin base B once DEPLOY is a strict descendant of B.
Unresolvable refs or symbols stay blocked with an explicit UNKNOWN reason, never silently unblocked.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1177. Blockers on tickets/obligations/rows are free text ('do not queue until commit X is deployed'); when the artifact ships into the deployed commit nothing re-evaluates them. Observed in one day: ~28 sessions ran on a ticket without queueing after X was deployed; a dozen 'no mock for S' items stayed blocked after a stand-in shipped; a role prompt pinned a base three deployments old; 'needs observer O' items stayed blocked two days after O shipped.
title: GH #1177: machine-checkable blocker conditions that re-evaluate when the deployment ref moves (ancestor/path/symbol), plus doctor for stale free-text blockers and pinned bases
